title: SKF_TEST_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-test-skill emits when {headless_mode} is true, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_TEST_RESULT_JSON: ': once when the report step has written the result contract (status success for a scored run, status error with halt_reason hard-gate-blocked for a run the hard gate blocked), and once at every HARD HALT (status error). The shared emitter, skf-emit-result-envelope.py, builds every line from the payload a stage stages in the run folder (the report step's from scripts/build-result-context.py), derives a halt's exit_code from halt_reason, stamps run_id and result_path, and checks the line against this schema, so the model never types it. A skill run cannot set the exit status of the agent that runs it, so automators read exit_code from this line or from skf-test-skill-result-latest.json. The skill's references/invocation-contract.md describes each halt.

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the wrapper, the status a halt carries, the exit code of each halt_reason and the result file stem. No success_exit_code: a scored run's exit_code follows its verdict (0 PASS, 2 FAIL, 3 INCONCLUSIVE, 4 pass-with-drift), which build-result-context.py derives. Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' when a scored run wrote its result contract (PASS, FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE or pass-with-drift: the workflow completed). 'error' on a HARD HALT, and on a run the hard gate blocked, which still writes the Gap Report and its FAIL result contract.

skill_name.description: The skill under test. Null only for a halt before the run had a name (a headless run given none halts input-missing).

verdict.description: The settled result: PASS, FAIL (a blocked run included), INCONCLUSIVE (the minimum-evidence floor) or pass-with-drift (a PASS under --allow-workspace-drift with drift observed, never exportable). Null on a halt before a verdict exists. The result file's summary.result spells the same verdict PASS, FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE or PASS_WITH_DRIFT.

score.description: The completeness score, in percent, from the scoring script. Null for a run the hard gate blocked (never scored) and on a halt.

threshold.description: The pass threshold the verdict was settled against, in percent: 80 when the threshold fallback fired (original_threshold holds the target). Null for a blocked run and on a halt.

report_path.description: The test report. A finished or blocked run names its published report, test-report-<skill>-<run_id>.md. A halt after the report was created names the in-progress copy, .skf-test-report-<skill>-<run_id>.md, which no consumer reads; null on a halt before it exists.

next_workflow.description: "export-skill" only when verdict is PASS; "update-skill" for FAIL (a blocked run included) and pass-with-drift; null for INCONCLUSIVE (route to manual review) and on a halt.

exit_code.description: The exit code the run settles on, for automators to branch on: 0 PASS, 2 FAIL (a blocked run's hard-gate-blocked included), 3 INCONCLUSIVE, 4 pass-with-drift, and 1 for every other halt_reason. A skill run cannot set the process exit status of the agent that runs it, so this field (or skf-test-skill-result-latest.json) is the place to read it.

halt_reason.description: Null for a scored run. On a halt, the failure class: input-missing (headless with no skill name), input-invalid (a --tier value that names no tier), runtime-missing (python3 or uv is not on PATH), helper-missing (an SKF helper is not installed), helper-failed (a helper or scoring script exited with an error), write-failed (the run folder, the report or the result contract could not be written), target-inaccessible (no version of the skill to test), not-skf-output, frontmatter-invalid, forge-tier-missing, workspace-drift, another-run-active, inventory-invalid (the documented inventory failed its schema check or spot-check twice), indeterminate-surface (zero exports, or an empty stack surface: no score can be attached), step-completeness-violation, report-anchor-missing, health-check-missing; hard-gate-blocked for a run the hard gate blocked (verdict FAIL, exit 2).

run_id.description: The run's id, stamped by the emitter from the run folder name: the UTC time the run took its lock and a random suffix, the {run_id} in the report's file name. Null for a halt before the run folder exists.

result_path.description: The per-run result file the emitter wrote in the version folder, skf-test-skill-result-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>.json (UTC; -2, -3 appended when a run took that second's name), beside its skf-test-skill-result-latest.json copy. Stamped by the emitter, never typed. Null on a halt, which writes no result file, and when the write failed (warnings say why).

threshold_fallback.description: Present, and true, only when the threshold fallback accepted the run at the 80% floor; absent (never false or null) otherwise.

original_threshold.description: The threshold the run was asked to meet, present only beside threshold_fallback.

warnings.description: Optional. Non-fatal anomalies the run recorded in its sink or the emitter raised, one string each, starting with its code: customization_resolver_unavailable when the customization resolver could not run, and result_file_write_failed when a result file could not be written. Present only when there is at least one.

phase.description: Where the run halted: the step and the check, for example 'init:runtime' or 'report:anchors'.

reason.description: The halt message the step displayed, on one line.

path.description: Optional path the failed operation targeted.

error.description: Present on a HARD HALT only: where the run stopped and why. Pipelines branch on halt_reason and read error for the diagnostic.
